newsitem.title: USA: Arvin to take Q4 charge for debentures.
newsitem.headline: Arvin to take Q4 charge for debentures.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Wednesday it expects to take a pre-tax charge of about $1.5 million in the fourth quarter for the redemption of its 7-1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures.

The debentures, due September 30, 2014, will be redeemed at 102.25 percent of the principal amount outstanding plus accrued and unpaid interest. The current outstanding principal of debentures of $63.8 million.
The redemption of the debentures will be funded by operating cash flow and bank credit facilities, it said.

Each debenture is convertible into common shares at a conversion price of $28.50 a common share. This is equivalent to 35 common shares for each $1,000 principal amount of debentures, plus a cash payment in lieu of any fractional share.
The right to convert the debentures into common shares will expire at 1700 CST on December 27.
Debenture holders who deliver their debentures for conversion prior to the close of business on December 6, the record date for payment of a $0.19 per share dividend, will receive the payout.
Arvin manufactures automotive components with 50 manufacturing facilities and eight technical centers located in 16 countries.
